usable_primary_source.title: A topological proof of the Hell–Nešetřil dichotomy
usable_primary_source.locator: Theorem 1.1 and Section 2.1, Definition 2.1; finite-graph convention in Section 2
usable_primary_source.scope: External theorem, not an independently re-proved dichotomy. Finite undirected fixed template H: polynomial for bipartite or looped H, NP-complete otherwise. F7 context assumes irreflexive graphs, so no-loop hypothesis holds.
